activation_requires: exact owner approval with site, artifact SHA, migration digest, backup/restore path, change window

external_source_rating.description: Immutable per-source observations (shikimori, amd_online, provider-feed KP/IMDb)

native_user_average.description: Space-scoped accepted community votes only; A = S/N

public_brand_score.description: Versioned composite for brand UI where policy defines a prior
public_brand_score.yummy: Bayesian shrink toward prior; m never counted in displayed vote_count

prior.double_count_guard: If Animedia native already embeds Shikimori as prior component, Yummy must not also add Shikimori; use Animedia-only or Shikimori-only with provenance.

dag: comments_foundation shares actors/subjects; never mutates rating_aggregates
invariants: one active vote per (rating_space_id, subject_id, actor_id, dimension)
idempotency same key+payload => same result; same key+diff payload => 409

rounding.compute: full Decimal precision; never feed rounded UI values back into next compute

legacy.animedia_blend_v1: AMD+local closed projection; retained for AMD last-good; not Animedia native UI label
legacy.LocalVotesService: superseded by community ledger; tables retained; no fake votes
